Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Complete borrowed TAR/ZIP metadata admission into one manual Prepared owner containing a sealed Plan and ordered Member table. TAR consumes the full footer; ZIP completes structural metadata before allocation, then both adapters apply the extraction profile and namespace policy to every member. Independent archive/namespace/payload oracles pass TAR26, ZIP26, limits58 and allocation10 process invocations: 120 across four Rust tests, including repeated baselines and eight reached source OOM cases with pre-exit release checks. Packed/nonzero and actual signed-stride -8 views execute. max_owned_bytes counts configured Plan+Member requested capacities only, excluding borrowed input, Run and later decoded ZIP owners. Metadata success does not verify ZIP payload integrity; consumers must call canonical zip::extract, including for empty directories.
